A short-lived '''civil war''' was fought on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derenzil/Legends|Derenzil]] in which both sides were supplied with highly specialized, [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]] by members of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The weapons were manufactured in a [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|factory]] on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] which was equipped with a [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] due to the risk of the project; however, the facility had been abandoned<ref name="Inside" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
The civil war on Derenzil was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', which was written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
